title: AI Help for Excel Debugging
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting ai help for excel debugging to Excel pivot-table finding with unit labels, source note, and claim-first chart title, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Read an Excel error code (#DIV/0!, #REF!, #VALUE!, #NAME?, #N/A) to predict the cause before asking for help.
Write a four-part debugging prompt: the formula, the wrong result, the suspected cause, and the exact desired behavior including the edge case.
Verify an AI-suggested formula on a known-answer row before copying it down.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
